verdict.rationale: Claude Code has documented sandboxing for its Bash tool that enforces OS-level filesystem and network isolation, letting commands run autonomously within defined boundaries rather than per-command approval — directly matching the engineering-lead's review-safety need. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification/testing of the sandbox's real-world robustness, and detail on sandbox coverage for non-Bash tool actions (e.g., MCP tool calls).
